chapters.title: Asking "When is your birthday?"

units.title: Materi: Asking "When is your birthday?"
units.content: Jika ingin menanyakan hari ulang tahun teman, kita bertanya: 'When is your birthday?' (Kapan hari ulang tahunmu?). units.title: Materi: Pronunciation of -ed Endings (/t/, /d/, and /id/)
units.content: The three distinct pronunciations of '-ed' endings: /t/, /d/, and /id/! 1. Sound /t/ after voiceless sounds: 'cooked', 'laughed'. 2. Sound /d/ after voiced sounds: 'played', 'cleaned'. 3. Sound /id/ after 't' and 'd' sounds: 'wanted', 'needed', adding an extra syllable!
